category_title: Students with hyperactive-impulsive behaviors who disrupt classroom instruction
scenario_title: Passive listening and silent reading during teacher instruction
minimal_context: The student is expected to sit and read silently while the teacher gives instructions to the class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright class, please stay seated and read the story silently while I go over the instructions for our next activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits with a dreamy and glazed look, not opening the book and not responding immediately to the instructions.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Did you hear me? It is time to read silently.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up and starts walking around the classroom when staying seated is expected, talking out of turn.) I don't want to read right now.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please go back to your seat and listen to the instructions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Interrupts the teacher's instruction, walks to a peer's desk, takes away their stationery items, and starts making noises and arguing with the peer.) No, I need this pencil! Vroom!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Alright class, please stay seated and read the story silently while I go over the instructions for our next activity.

STUDENT: (Sits with a dreamy and glazed look, not opening the book and not responding immediately to the instructions.)

TUTOR: Did you hear me? It is time to read silently.

STUDENT: (Stands up and starts walking around the classroom when staying seated is expected, talking out of turn.) I don't want to read right now.

TUTOR: Please go back to your seat and listen to the instructions.

STUDENT: (Interrupts the teacher's instruction, walks to a peer's desk, takes away their stationery items, and starts making noises and arguing with the peer.) No, I need this pencil! Vroom!
